name: 管装温和保湿面霜款
description: 白底托霜与高饱蓝双底，三联质地微距与肤况分屏推进到信息收口

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF packshot field, one flat saturated cyan-blue accent field #0FA3DD, and a single broad cream ribbon #F4F0EA as the only background device; no scenery, no gradient mesh
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool neutral high-key studio light, large soft front-left key with fill card, low-contrast soft contact shadows, no hard speculars, skimming sweep only on texture macro
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone counter #E7E2DC for the one vanity scene, pale card stock #E9EEF2 for the information spread
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, wide letter-spacing, two-line claim blocks in charcoal #1E2226 with one word repeated in the accent blue, generous margins
styleLock.iconSystem: hairline callout rules and single-weight thin-line marks only, one accent color, no filled pictograms
styleLock.presentationRules: product always upright on its own cap, identical slight 3/4 or straight-on hero angle and scale across the set, never tilted, never floating without a contact shadow
noDrift: no extra props beyond the cream ribbon
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clinical-apothecary skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, one saturated cyan-blue accent field #0FA3DD, cream-ivory texture #F4F0EA and charcoal type #1E2226; cool neutral high-key studio lighting with a large soft front-left key and fill card, low-contrast soft contact shadows, no hard speculars; modern geometric sans-serif with wide letter-spacing and generous margins; hairline callout rules and thin single-weight line icons only; product presented upright on its own cap at a stable slight 3/4 or straight-on angle with unchanging scale; flat color fields and one broad cream ribbon as the only background devices; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no decorative props beyond the cream ribbon.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用乳霜旋纹托底暗示膏体质地
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, tube upright on its flip cap, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, large soft front-left key with fill card, one soft contact shadow
shots.background: seamless pure white #FFFFFF with one broad glossy cream ribbon #F4F0EA sweeping diagonally behind the tube
shots.promptTemplate: Product hero photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The tube standing upright on its flip cap, straight-on eye-level view, full product visible and unclipped. Bright even high-key studio lighting, large soft front-left key with a fill card on the shadow side, one soft contact shadow grounding the product. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF with one broad glossy ribbon of cream #F4F0EA sweeping diagonally behind the tube. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace. 8K, commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no people, no watermark, no invented logo, no overlaid marketing text, no second unit, no cut-off edges, no gradient background, no floating product without a contact shadow.

shots.intent: 一秒给出第一购买理由，用整面强调色抢注意力
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, tube upright on the right side of frame
shots.lighting: soft front key with gentle falloff, one soft contact shadow, cool 5600K
shots.background: one flat saturated accent field, {accent_color} #0FA3DD, edge to edge
shots.whitespace: generous clean negative space on the left 45% for the claim block
shots.textZone: left 45% column, one short headline placeholder 「{selling_point_1}」 over one supporting line 「{callout_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The tube standing upright at a slight 3/4 hero angle on the right side of the frame. Background is one flat saturated accent field, {accent_color} #0FA3DD, covering the frame edge to edge, with a soft front key light, gentle falloff and one soft contact shadow, 5600K. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, with generous clean negative space on the left 45% reserved for the claim block: one short headline placeholder in charcoal #1E2226 reading 「{selling_point_1}」 over one supporting line reading 「{callout_1}」. Negative: no more than two text blocks, no dense body text, no durations, hours or test figures, no invented percentages, no white background, no watermark, no invented logo, no distorted tube silhouette.

shots.intent: 承接主视觉，用两行大字补足第二与第三利益点
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, tube upright in the left third of frame
shots.lighting: bright high-key studio light, soft front key, one soft contact shadow
shots.background: seamless white #FFFFFF with a broad soft cream smear #F4F0EA pooling along the lower left
shots.whitespace: clean negative space across the right half for two stacked claim lines
shots.textZone: right half, two stacked headline placeholders 「{selling_point_2}」 and 「{selling_point_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level camera, the tube standing upright in the left third of the frame, a broad soft smear of cream pooling along the lower-left edge. Bright high-key studio lighting with a soft front key and one soft contact shadow. Background seamless white #FFFFFF with a broad soft cream ribbon #F4F0EA behind the product. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, clean negative space across the right half reserved for two stacked claim lines in charcoal #1E2226 reading 「{selling_point_2}」 and 「{selling_point_3}」, with one word of each line repeated in {accent_color} #0FA3DD. Negative: no third claim, no paragraph body text, no clinical figures or test timings, no comparison arrows, no props, no hands, no watermark, no invented logo.

shots.intent: 用三联质地语言解释膏体结构，支撑核心卖点
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro photographed square-on across three matched vertical panels
shots.lighting: soft back light plus a skimming top sweep revealing refraction and depth
shots.background: three matched vertical texture panels divided by hairline rules in {accent_color} #0FA3DD
shots.props: the slim upright product standing small at the lower centre seam
shots.whitespace: minimal, the three panels bleed to the frame edges
shots.textZone: one short label placeholder at the top of each panel reading 「{callout_2}」, 「{callout_3}」 and 「{callout_4}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Three matched vertical extreme close-up macro panels photographed square-on and divided by hairline rules in {accent_color} #0FA3DD: left panel faceted crystalline texture in cool violet-grey #8E86B4, centre panel clear refractive droplet spheres in bright cyan #58C7EC, right panel fine bubbles suspended in deep cerulean #2C6FA8; the slim upright product stands small at the lower centre seam. Soft back light plus a skimming top sweep to reveal refraction and depth. The three panels together fill 55-60% of the frame with one short label placeholder at the top of each panel reading 「{callout_2}」, 「{callout_3}」 and 「{callout_4}」 in charcoal #1E2226. Whitespace kept minimal, the panels bleed to the edges. Negative: no ingredient names or chemical labels, no readable fine print, no fabricated laboratory imagery, no dense body text, no duplicated texture tiling, no watermark, no invented logo.

shots.intent: 以肤况微距与引注线证明肤感与涂展性
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom on a cheek texture crop at a very low skimming angle, no facial feature in frame
shots.lighting: soft key from the upper left plus a skimming sweep across the surface, 5200K, shallow depth of field with sharp foreground
shots.background: bare skin field filling the frame edge to edge in a soft neutral tone #C7A489
shots.props: one round dab of cream at the centre, hairline callout rules
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture is the subject
shots.textZone: two short label placeholders joined by hairline rules reading 「{callout_5}」 and 「{callout_6}」
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of bare skin touched by cream from {product}, a tight zoom on a cheek-area texture crop photographed at a very low skimming angle so the surface relief reads, framed so that no eyes, brows, lips or hairline fall inside the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground texture sharp, soft key from the upper left plus a skimming sweep of light across the surface, 5200K. The skin field fills the frame edge to edge in a soft neutral tone #C7A489, with one round dab of cream #F7F4EF at the centre and hairline callout rules in #FFFFFF leading to two short label placeholders reading 「{callout_5}」 and 「{callout_6}」. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, minimal whitespace. Negative: no identifiable face or portrait, no full head, no hands or fingers, no airbrushed plastic skin, no erased pores, no invented test data, no watermark, no invented logo.

shots.intent: 用同机位双栏分屏说明广适配肤况，消除选择疑虑
shots.camera: two matched panels photographed square-on with identical framing and identical crop
shots.lighting: identical soft high-key studio light on both panels, same shadow direction
shots.background: the same soft cool grey seamless field #E6EDF1 on both panels
shots.props: the slim upright product standing small at the lower right seam
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, both panels bleed to the edges
shots.textZone: one short line across the lower band reading 「{selling_point_4}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison screen, two matched side-by-side panels with identical framing, identical crop and identical soft studio light. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Each panel shows only a cropped cheek-and-jaw texture area of bare skin with one swatch of cream #FFFFFF dabbed on it, deliberately different neutral skin depths across the two panels, photographed square-on and framed so that no eyes, lips or facial identity are visible. Background on both panels is the same soft cool grey seamless field #E6EDF1. The slim upright product stands small at the lower right seam. The two panels together occupy 50-60% of the frame, with one short line placeholder across the lower band in charcoal #1E2226 reading 「{selling_point_4}」, no extra whitespace. Negative: no recognizable person or model identity, no hands, no before-and-after result delta implied, no competitor product, no mismatched lighting or scale between panels, no watermark, no invented logo.

shots.intent: 把使用提示转成可代入的台面场景，建立日常习惯
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down over a bathroom counter
shots.lighting: soft morning window light from the left at 5500K with gentle fill, one soft contact shadow
shots.background: matte light-stone counter #E7E2DC against a soft pale backdrop #F4F0EA
shots.props: a small pale ceramic dish holding a pea-sized swirl of cream and one folded towel at the far edge, neither covering the product
shots.whitespace: clean margin across the upper right for two short step lines
shots.textZone: upper right, two short numbered step lines reading 「{callout_7}」 and 「{callout_8}」
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle usage scene: {product} standing on a matte light-stone bathroom counter #E7E2DC, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft morning window light from the left at 5500K with a gentle fill, one soft contact shadow grounding the tube. Props: a small pale ceramic dish holding a pea-sized swirl of cream #F7F4EF and one neatly folded towel at the far edge, neither covering the product, against a soft pale backdrop #F4F0EA. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame, with a clean margin across the upper right for two short step lines in charcoal #1E2226 reading 「{callout_7}」 and 「{callout_8}」. Negative: no hands, no face, no mirror reflections, no bathroom clutter, no invented dosage or duration instructions, no marketing text printed on surrounding surfaces, no watermark, no invented logo.

shots.intent: 给出步骤化组合选择位，抬升客单与搭配率
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level row, all three units upright on one shared baseline
shots.lighting: bright even high-key lighting identical across all three units, three soft contact shadows
shots.background: seamless pure white #FFFFFF with one broad cream ribbon #F4F0EA behind the middle unit
shots.props: three empty outlined numeral rings above the units and one empty caption bar below each unit
shots.textZone: one caption bar under the hero unit reading 「{selling_point_5}」, the other two bars left empty
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant and routine lineup of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Three units standing upright on one shared baseline, photographed straight-on at eye-level: a tall pump bottle at the left, a slim cylindrical can at the centre and the tube at the right, each with one empty outlined numeral ring floating above it and one empty caption bar beneath it, the caption under the tube in charcoal #1E2226 reading 「{selling_point_5}」. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF with one broad soft ribbon of cream #F4F0EA sweeping behind the middle unit. Bright even high-key lighting identical across all three units with three soft contact shadows. The lineup fills 70-80% of the frame overall, minimal whitespace. Negative: no brand marks or readable label text on the companion units, no invented price, bundle discount or saving figure, no mixed lighting between units, no duplicated products, no hands, no watermark, no invented logo.

shots.intent: 用空白参数栏与空印章框收口降险，杜绝伪造资质
shots.camera: flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle
shots.lighting: even flat high-key lighting, no dramatic shadow, one faint edge shadow under each card
shots.background: pale blue-grey studio field #E9EEF2 carrying two side-by-side cards, the left card clean white #FFFFFF
shots.props: one blank credential card with one accent rule, four empty parameter rows and one empty seal outline
shots.whitespace: generous empty margin on the right reserved for credentials composited later
shots.textZone: right card: four empty parameter rows plus one short caption line reading 「{callout_9}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust and information screen, flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two side-by-side cards on a pale blue-grey studio field #E9EEF2: the left card carries the upright product at a slight 3/4 angle on a clean white #FFFFFF panel, the right card is a blank credential layout with one accent rule in {accent_color} #0FA3DD, four empty parameter rows, one empty seal outline and one short caption line in charcoal #1E2226 reading 「{callout_9}」. Even flat high-key lighting, no dramatic shadow, only a faint edge shadow under each card. The two cards together fill 35-40% of the frame with generous empty margin on the right reserved for credentials composited later. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, laboratory figures, ratings, sales counts, ingredient names, volumes or efficacy claims; no scannable codes or square code blocks, no dense body text, no marketplace badges or star-rating strips, no watermark, no invented logo.

provenance.notes: 9 张源图逐图事实：001 软管立于白色乳霜旋纹上的白底主图；002 三联竖幅质地微距（晶面／液滴／气泡）各带栏目标题位；003 脸颊肤况极特写＋细线引注＋三处主张文字；004 白底乳霜拖尾，产品靠左、右侧两段大字主张；005 整面高饱和强调蓝底，产品靠右、左侧大字主张；006 双栏肤色对照分屏＋右下产品小图＋底部大字；007 白底产品＋右侧使用提示排版；008 三件步骤横排＋超大序号与底部名称位；009 正反面双栏背标信息（细则段落＋一个扫码块＋容量字样）。品类判定：以图为准，膏体涂于面部脸颊、管装乳霜形态，故 L1 护肤个护／L2 面部护理，未沿用源类目路径。已剥离：品牌字标与系列名、管身全部印刷文字、原文案原句、功效／时长／成分／容量等一切数值断言、机构推荐与检测背书、扫码与防伪块、两位模特的面容与身份、平台角标与星级条；所有主张改为 {selling_point_n}／{callout_n} 空位或空白参数行、空印章框、空序号环。007 的使用提示排版转译为台面场景镜；003／006 的人物面部改为无识别特征的肤况裁切。
